skill_name: Create a paragraph with at least six sentences about the given topic.
workflow: Friendship is an essential part of life. It helps us to form meaningful connections with people and enrich our lives. Friendship is one of the most important relationships we can have, and it can provide us with support, warmth, and comfort. Studies have shown that having friends is associated with greater physical and mental health and can help us cope with life's difficulties. Friends also provide us with a sense of belonging, understanding, and trust. Friendship encourages us to be more open
